import os,glob,re
def load():

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

G=load(); print(sorted(G))

src='''def transform(g):
    from collections import Counter
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    def comp(i,j,c):
        st=[(i,j)]; cells=[]
        while st:
            a,b=st.pop()
            if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and not seen[a][b] and g[a][b]==c:
                seen[a][b]=True; cells.append((a,b))
                st+=[(a+1,b),(a-1,b),(a,b+1),(a,b-1)]
        return cells
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            c=g[i][j]
            if c==bg or seen[i][j]: continue
            cells=comp(i,j,c)
            rs=[a for a,b in cells]; cs=[b for a,b in cells]
            r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
            border={(a,b) for a in range(r0,r1+1) for b in range(c0,c1+1)
                    if a in(r0,r1) or b in(c0,c1)}
            if set(cells)==border and r1>r0+1 and c1>c0+1:
                area=(r1-r0-1)*(c1-c0-1)
                fill=2 if area%2==0 else 7
                for a in range(r0+1,r1):
                    for b in range(c0+1,c1):
                        if g[a][b]!=c: out[a][b]=fill
    return out
'''
